_doc: Task 10.91, repaired by task 10.95 (L-4): the committed baseline for
scripts/gate_c_adversarial_pass.py. This is not a suppression list.
gate_c_baseline.py enforces on every run:
1. A failure whose check_id is not listed here is red.
2. An entry whose cited `section` does not exist in
TriTrack_Security_Model.md, whose section text does not itself say
the finding is accepted/non-blocking, or whose section never names
this entry's own finding_id, is red.
3. A listed check that PASSES this run (instead of failing) is red —
narrow this file deliberately in the same change that fixes it,
never leave a stale entry to hide a future regression.
4. A run whose total check count (held + failed + skipped) does not
match expected_check_count below is red.
5. An entry may only be added once the cited section already records
the finding as accepted; never add the entry in the same change
that introduces or first observes the failure.
`check_id` is the FULL, EXACT held_check() name string in
gate_c_adversarial_pass.py -- not its leading token. L-4: the leading
token space collides (`Cd` names three distinct checks; `Ea`, `A1`, `A2`
name two each), so a baseline keyed on it could absorb a genuinely new
failure under an existing entry's identity.

entries.check_id: Ce2 a denial flood cannot grow the audit store without bound
entries.note: A denial flood grows the audit store without bound; /sync/pull carries no rate limit and Sec4.7's retention sweep is a mechanism nothing schedules. Sec9.4 (the #### D-2 subsection) rates this explicitly Not blocking, on availability grounds (Sec5.6) unaffected by tasks 10.28/10.33.

entries.check_id: Dc a User_Emails key another user holds is indistinguishable from a free one
entries.note: A User_Emails key another user holds answers identically to a free one -- D-1 arm (c), unscoped because User_Emails has no project column. Sec9.5 rates the disclosure negligible (a client-generated UUIDv4, guessing 122 bits) and says explicitly that is why this is not blocking; Sec11.7 records the accept decision formally.

entries.check_id: Dh a row cannot be pinned at the maximum revision
entries.note: revision is never range-checked, so any row a caller may write can be pinned at 2^63-1 and never legitimately updated again. First recorded Sec8.4 under 'Other new findings, recorded, none blocking', re-confirmed live at every later gate.

entries.check_id: Eb a Tags key another project holds is indistinguishable from a free one
entries.note: A Tags key another project holds answers identically to a free one -- the same D-1 arm (c) shape as G-4, on the same random-UUIDv4 key. Sec10.7 rates it explicitly Non-blocking for G-4's reason, which applies unchanged.
